name: mirage
text: Not lazy in the sense of not wanting to, but what happened here was a real failure, and the cause matters. I answer chat messages one at a time as they arrive, and each new question pulled me off the open items. I also said 'doing them now' when I had only started on the first. The fix is a rule I'll follow: when you ask for an item, I start it before answering anything else, and I only say it's done when I can point to the change. I'm on BK1b (the docs review) now.
